svg.title: Forge UGC — Games
svg.desc: Measured native vector reconstruction of the newly generated Games screen. Illustrated media are individually traced sample placeholders; labels and controls remain editable. The three illustrated destinations are fixed decorative scenes. All destinations are free. The mini-game count and currency counters are live placeholders.
svg.text: Take a break. Find your next challenge.
Style a look. Walk the runway.
Relax in the lounge. Earn tokens.
